title: Returned-Payment Fees Collected With a Grace-Cure Payment (Premium Billing Accounts)
content:
Returned-payment fees on Premium Billing Accounts are collected with the grace-cure payment according to how the account pays; the first case that holds decides. This amount is added to the past-due premium; the total, after any deduction, is floored at 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

- **The account left AutoPay.** Every returned-payment fee booked within twelve months before the payment date is collected, because removal of automatic draft settles the returned items counted toward it.
- **Otherwise, the arrangement carries no AutoPay discount.** The returned-payment fee booked last is collected when it counts as booked in the grace period; otherwise no fee is collected.
- **Otherwise — an arrangement that drafts** (Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly, the only arrangement carrying an AutoPay discount). No fee is collected; the next automatic draft collects it once the grace period is cured.

The account *left AutoPay* when its arrangement carries no AutoPay discount and does not accept bank draft (EFT), and the account nevertheless collected at least one regular automatic draft within twelve months before the payment date — which only the AutoPay arrangement it was moved from when automatic draft was removed could have collected. The returned-payment fee booked last is the fee booked last on the account (of two booked on the same day, the one recorded first), and it counts as booked in the grace period when its date is on or after the grace-period start date; where no grace-period start date is on record it does not. A record falls within a number of months before the payment date when the whole calendar months from its date to the payment date, counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it), are fewer than that number.

**Hypothetical cases** (grace-period start date 1 August; payment date 19 October).
| Account | Fees on the ledger | Collected |
|---|---|---|
| left AutoPay | 25.00 on 12 February, 25.00 on 3 August | 50.00 |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 25.00 on 3 August (booked last) | 25.00 |
| Cascade Individual Quarterly Bill | 25.00 on 28 July (booked last) | nothing — booked before 1 August |
| Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly | 25.00 on 3 August | nothing |
